newsitem.title: GERMANY: Hoechst says HMR profit improved markedly.
newsitem.headline: Hoechst says HMR profit improved markedly.

text.p: German chemicals and drugs group Hoechst AG said on Wednesday that the operating profit at its drugs unit Hoechst Marion Roussel (HMR) has improved "considerably" in the first nine months.
In the first nine months of the year the operating profit rose to two billion marks, the company said in a statement.
Business is progressing particularly well in the U.S., western Europe and Germany, but was slightly weaker than expected in Japan.
Hoechst said that excluding special factors, HMR's operating margin was 18 percent.
